name: [ORCS] Solo Hunters
desc:
⚔️ SOLO HUNTERS

Enter the gates. Face what waits inside. Rise from E-rank to S.

🔴 MONARCH OF WHITE FLAMES ISLAND — THE MONARCH OF WHITE FLAMES
Clear Ezril's three Trials to unlock the hardest raid in the game. Phases,
arena-wide flames, and a boss who stops for no one.

💀 ARISE — COMMAND THE DEAD
Extract the souls of what you kill and raise them as your shadows. Level them,
build them through shadow skill trees, and send them into battle beside you.

⚡ MASTER YOUR HUNT
🔥 Gates that open into new worlds and stronger bosses
🏅 Rank up E → S and unlock new power as you climb
⏫ Level up and spend stat points your way
⚔️ Loot legendary swords and runes, each with their own ability kits
✨ Classes, Class Skill Trees and Blessing Stones
🏰 Guilds, daily rewards and leaderboards

How strong will you get?
